style: Casual, fast, unpolished — talking to a friend, not performing. The Dialed Moods can stays on the counter beside her, label unchanged and legible. Shot on a phone front camera, window light from her left, real skin texture. Quiet kitchen room tone, no music, no on-screen text, no captions.
opening: Okay so I'm not a supplement person at all, but my focus had gotten genuinely bad. Like, reread the same email four times bad.
extensions: Someone at work had these, and I figured worst case it's a fancy seltzer. That was about two months ago.
What I actually notice is I sit down and just... start. No twenty minutes of deciding to start first.
That's the whole review, honestly. It's the L-Doba one. Clean energy and calm focus, like it says on the can.
